Bowling score-sheet fixtures. Photos are real QubicaAMF lane screens: `night_NN.jpg` are
end-of-night RESULTS tables (supplied 2026-08-28; night_05 2026-09-05) and `game_NN.jpg` are
end-of-game frame strips (game_01 is a different vendor's screen; game_02..04 are QubicaAMF,
2026-09-05, tilted photos with a circled split digit in game_04). `<stem>_truth.json` is the
hand-transcribed ground truth (night rows checksum-verified: sum(games)==scratch,
scratch+hdcp==total; game frames re-scored to the printed total). `<stem>_ocr.json` (when
present) is the cached Vision symbol dump so tests run offline.
